description: pixel art landscape, the colossal trunk of the world tree rising like a cliff: its bark forming deep canyons, golden amber cascades running down, huge bracket fungi like terraces, wild beehives in dark hollows, clouds drifting around the trunk, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, very dark muted palette of bark brown, amber gold and dim grey, no text, no border, no people in front, no animals in front
